name: Mini Herb Baguettes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Combine flour, yeast, salt, powdered oregano, rosemary powder, and thyme.
Gradually mix the water into the flour, kneading until elastic. Let stand 30 minutes.
Weigh out 100 g of dough, and let rest for 10 minutes. Shape the dough into a long loaf. Repeat with remaining dough.
Transfer loaves to a baking sheet sprinkled with flour. Make slices in the top with a sharp knife or blade. Let rise 50 minutes until fluffy.
Spray loaves with water. Bake 25 minutes in a 200°C oven until cooked through.

culture.text: A baguette is a long, thin type of bread commonly made from basic lean dough. Both the dough and the physical dimensions of the traditional baguette are defined by French law. It is distinguishable by its length and crisp crust.
